_: Per-suite end-to-end durations, harvested from ONE real CI run. WHAT THIS IS: the input to the shard assignment in .github/workflows/ci.yml, so that assignment is derived from data rather than from an impression. Consumed only by check:e2e-roster's PRINTED summary. WHAT THIS IS NOT: a budget, a bar, or anything any gate asserts against. No test compares a wall-clock time to a number in this file, and none may: docs/specs/ci-sharding/feature-spec.md 1.4 forbids a wall-clock assertion anywhere in this epic, because five samples of the same job span 40-47 minutes and the slowest measured altered no test at all. These are ratios that happen to carry units. STALENESS: the run id and date below are printed beside every projection, so a reader sees the projection's age at the same time as the projection. They will drift as suites are added and that is expected; re-harvest rather than trusting them. RE-HARVEST 2026-10-12 (toolbar-grid M5-T4, docs/TECH_DEBT.md #491): every figure was re-read from the step timings of run 38290423490 (PR #949's final run, the four web shard jobs 114948906562, 114948906584, 114948906657 and 114948906674; `job` above is the longest, shard 2), one step per test:e2e script, mapped by the script the step runs; the two API figures are the 'API end-to-end tests' and 'Pairwise differential' steps of job 114948906053. This replaces the 2026-09-11 harvest (run 34613280766) AND every local or estimated entry earlier addenda recorded (page-composition, forced-colors, arrange, netpoint-grammar, splitting, promotion); those are now CI figures. Step timings are whole seconds, and a step includes its own server start, so a suite that builds first (forced-colors, splitting) carries the build here, unlike the earlier local figures. The run is one sample on shared runners: read it for ratios.
